title: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Backend Developer
description:
Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop and enhance backend solutions on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). Develop custom AEM components, services, workflows and reusable capabilities. Build solutions using Java, OSGi, Apache Sling and JCR. Develop Sling Models, Servlets, schedulers and backend services. Work with Content Fragments, Experience Fragments, DAM and AEM Sites capabilities as required. Develop and support integrations between AEM and enterprise or third-party platforms using APIs and services. Troubleshoot application, integration and performance issues across AEM environments. Follow coding standards and participate in code reviews, unit testing and technical quality assurance. Work closely with architects, frontend developers, QA and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Support deployments, defect resolution and production stabilization activities. 
 Required Skills Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager / AEM Sites. Strong Java development experience. Hands-on experience with: OSGi Apache Sling JCR Sling Models Sling Servlets AEM Components and Templates Content Fragments / Experience Fragments DAM REST APIs / integrations Good understanding of AEM development and deployment practices. Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience working within enterprise development teams and established SDLC processes.

Key Skills: Java,AEM,Osgi,Apache Sling,Rest API Integration,Adobe Experience Management,Backend,Adobe
